title: PyTorch Paper Replicating: Main Takeaways, Exercises and Extra-Curriculum

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: We have come a long way.
cues.zh: 我們已經走了很長一段路。

cues.en: Look at all the code we've written.
cues.zh: 看看寫了多少程式碼。

cues.en: Oh, my goodness.
cues.zh: 天啊。

cues.en: Replicating a machine learning research paper from scratch with PyTorch.
cues.zh: 用 PyTorch 從零重現一篇機器學習研究論文。

cues.en: But now we have some main takeaways.
cues.zh: 現在來整理幾個重點收穫。

cues.en: So let's go one a bit too far.
cues.zh: 往下移一下，啊，移得太遠了。

cues.en: Main takeaways from it.
cues.zh: 來看看這一節的重點。

cues.en: So with the explosion of machine learning, new research papers are coming out basically every day.
cues.zh: 隨著機器學習快速發展，幾乎每天都有新的研究論文發表。

cues.en: And yes, as you'll quickly find out, it's impossible to keep up with all of it.
cues.zh: 而且你很快就會發現，根本不可能跟上所有研究。

cues.en: But as we've done, we narrowed it down to our own use case and we replicated a computer vision paper for food Vision Many we stuck with our Food Vision mini problem.
cues.zh: 不過，正如我們所做的，可以把範圍縮小到自己的使用情境。我們為 FoodVision Mini 重現一篇電腦視覺論文，一直圍繞同一個問題。

cues.en: And what I kind of wanted to convey in this section is not really the overall concept of replicating a machine learning research paper.
cues.zh: 這一節我想傳達的，與其說是一套重現所有機器學習論文的通用概念，

cues.en: As in it's going to be different per paper.
cues.zh: 畢竟每篇論文都不一樣，

cues.en: I would rather show you how to do one so that you can take the principles that we've learned here and adapt them to others.
cues.zh: 不如實際示範如何重現其中一篇，讓你把這裡學到的原則運用到其他論文。

cues.en: So machine learning research papers often contain months of research.
cues.zh: 機器學習研究論文通常包含好幾個月的研究成果。

cues.en: That's something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 這點要記在心裡。

cues.en: We've seen this before, but this beautiful piece of research is from a group of 12 wonderful people from the Google Research Brain team.
cues.zh: 我們先前看過，這份很棒的研究出自 Google Research Brain 團隊的 12 位研究者。

cues.en: So it makes complete sense if a lot of what we've covered in here doesn't quite make sense.
cues.zh: 所以，如果第一次接觸時，這裡許多內容還不能完全理解，是很合理的。

cues.en: The first time I've read this paper, probably a dozen or maybe that's too many six, seven times now.
cues.zh: 這篇論文我大概讀了十幾次，或許沒那麼多，現在大概六、七次。

cues.en: And every time I do, I pick up something new.
cues.zh: 每次讀，我都會學到新東西。

cues.en: So the only reason we were able to go through all these steps is because I've had practice reading research papers like this and translating them into code.
cues.zh: 我們能一步步完成這些內容，只是因為我練習過閱讀這類研究論文，並把它們轉成程式碼。

cues.en: And eventually you'll be able to do the same thing too.
cues.zh: 最後你也能做到同樣的事。

cues.en: So if we come back and the goal of paper replicating is to do exactly what we did, we turned text,
cues.zh: 回到這裡，論文重現的目標正是我們剛才做的：把文字、

cues.en: math and images into usable PyTorch code so we could in fact save our visit If we go up here putting
cues.zh: 數學和圖像轉成可用的 PyTorch 程式碼。其實我們可以把 ViT 儲存起來；往上看，

cues.en: it all together to create fit, we could save this plus some other classes to a python file.
cues.zh: 在整合所有部分建立 ViT 的地方，可以把這個類別和其他幾個類別一起存成 Python 檔案。

cues.en: Going modular, going modular.
cues.zh: 也就是模組化，把它模組化。

cues.en: Save it to vit pi, something like that.
cues.zh: 例如存成 vit.py。

cues.en: And then we could just import our pre-trained model.
cues.zh: 接著就能匯入自己的模型；講者這裡稱它為預訓練模型。

cues.en: So from vet import vet and then we would have access to it.
cues.zh: 例如寫 from vit import ViT，就可以使用它。

cues.en: So that's the whole goal of paper replicating turn text images and math equations into usable code and come back.
cues.zh: 所以論文重現的整體目標，就是把文字、圖像和數學方程式轉成可用程式碼。回到下方。

cues.en: Many new research papers and teams are starting to publish their codes with papers on one of the best sites, papers with code.
cues.zh: 許多新的研究論文與團隊開始隨論文公開程式碼，其中很棒的一個網站就是 Papers with Code。

cues.en: I read this fairly often.
cues.zh: 我滿常看這個網站。

cues.en: I don't understand 90% of what's going on, but if I find something that's associated to the problem that I'm working on, well then I have a look at it and see if there's code associated with it.
cues.zh: 裡面 90% 的內容我都不懂，不過如果發現與自己正在處理的問題相關，就會看看有沒有相應的程式碼。

cues.en: Then if we keep going.
cues.zh: 再往下看。

cues.en: If we break things down, a research paper in a whole sense can be quite intimidating.
cues.zh: 整篇研究論文可能讓人望而生畏，不過可以把它拆開。

cues.en: But if we break it down into inputs and outputs, layers and blocks, we learn that a layer takes an input, perform some sort of function and creates an output.
cues.zh: 把它拆成輸入、輸出、層和區塊，就知道一個層會接收輸入、執行某種函式，再產生輸出。

cues.en: And then a block is a stack of layers, and a block takes some inputs and outputs.
cues.zh: 區塊則由多個層堆疊而成，也有自己的輸入與輸出。

cues.en: And then finally, a model is often a stack of blocks, just like our vision transformer.
cues.zh: 最後，模型往往是由多個區塊堆疊而成，就像我們的 Vision Transformer。

cues.en: A single layer could be the multi-headed tension layer.
cues.zh: 單一層可以是多頭注意力層。

cues.en: Then the block could be the transformer encoder.
cues.zh: 一個區塊可以是 Transformer 編碼器。

cues.en: Then the overall model could be a stack of transformer encoders.
cues.zh: 整個模型則可以是一疊 Transformer 編碼器。

cues.en: So if we go back down, we've learned a whole bunch in this section.
cues.zh: 再往下看，這一節我們學了很多。

cues.en: Pre-trained models are available for many state of the art model architectures, and with the power of transfer learning, these often perform very well with little data.
cues.zh: 許多最先進的模型架構都有預訓練模型可用，搭配遷移學習，即使資料很少，也經常表現良好。

cues.en: So that's what we saw.
cues.zh: 這就是我們觀察到的。

cues.en: We just saw how quickly we could get a pre-trained vet, adjust it to our own problem and make it work quite well.
cues.zh: 我們剛剛看到了，如何快速取得預訓練 ViT、把它調整成適合自己的問題，並得到相當好的效果。

cues.en: And finally, we've seen this.
cues.zh: 最後，這點我們也看過了。

cues.en: This was the last point.
cues.zh: 這是最後一個重點。

cues.en: We covered larger models, which is our model has 86 million parameters or thereabouts.
cues.zh: 我們介紹了較大的模型；自己的模型大約有 8,600 萬個參數。

cues.en: Generally performs better, but it has a larger footprint.
cues.zh: 一般來說，較大的模型表現較好，不過占用的資源也更多。

cues.en: So perhaps that is something to ask yourself is when you want to deploy it.
cues.zh: 所以，當你想部署模型時，或許該問問自己，

cues.en: In other words, put it into an application.
cues.zh: 也就是把模型放進應用程式時，

cues.en: Is that extra performance of a larger model worth it?
cues.zh: 大型模型帶來的額外效能值得嗎？

cues.en: Slash aligned with our use case?
cues.zh: 它符合我們的使用情境嗎？

cues.en: And if we wanted to deploy our Food Vision mini app like traffic app so someone could upload an image
cues.zh: 如果我們想把 FoodVision Mini 部署成像前面那個 app 一樣的服務，讓使用者上傳影像，

cues.en: and have it classified in the browser, perhaps a model that's 327 megabytes is too big for what we're trying to do.
cues.zh: 並在瀏覽器中完成分類，那麼 327 MB 的模型對我們的目標而言，或許太大了。

cues.en: Now, that might not always be the case, but it's something to definitely think about.
cues.zh: 情況不一定總是如此，但這確實值得思考。
